description: Fragmentation of decoded CFM molecules — the failure mode that BLK-C11 is actually about, once the (withdrawn) valence story is set aside.
source_script: RDKit on the generated_smiles.csv of three real CFM runs
protocol: every decoded SMILES, metal atoms identified by symbol, n_fragments via Chem.GetMolFrags

headline.statement: Half of the decoded molecules come out as two or more disconnected fragments, and in 23% of them the metal centre has NO bonds at all. Every zero-coordination case is also a multi-fragment case — these are one failure, not two.

note_on_the_odd_run: cfm_blk_c5_repair splits the two rates: 1.4% detached metal but 81.6% multi-fragment. So the ligands fall off while the metal usually stays attached there — fragmentation and metal-detachment are strongly but not perfectly coupled, and any objective should be scored on both.

why_this_is_the_real_blocker.the_term_that_targets_it: molmetal/molmetal_lam/lam_chem/assemble_connectivity.py::assemble_fragment_loss, wired into the loss sum as `assemble_term`
why_this_is_the_real_blocker.measured_defect: the shipped 'product' aggregation returns prod_{k=1..12}(P^k)[i,i], whose gradient scales with the product. MEASURED at the logits: ~5e-09 in every case — connected chain 4.62e-09, metal-isolated 6.17e-09, weak bonds 3.98e-08 — against a bond_ce gradient of O(1). It is ~8 orders of magnitude too small to train anything.
why_this_is_the_real_blocker.consequence: assemble_loss_weight is 0.0 in every config on disk, and even at weight 1.0 the term read exactly 0.0 on the tmQM cohort because the product underflows on a connected graph. Enabling it as-is would be the FLAG_ONLY failure this module was written to prevent, one level up.
why_this_is_the_real_blocker.reformulation: `formulation='escape_time'` takes the ARITHMETIC mean of the same per-step stay probabilities instead of their product. Same ordering, bounded in [0,1], gradient ~3.5e-04 to 2.6e-03 — about 7e4x larger. All four invariants the module was written for still hold.
why_this_is_the_real_blocker.NOT_MADE_DEFAULT: Flipping the default breaks 10 of 21 tests, including test_fully_connected_graph_has_near_zero_gradient, which pins 'a connected graph gets no gradient' as a DELIBERATE property. The two formulations are in genuine tension and the choice is a judgement call, not a bug fix. Left opt-in; see todo.json BLK-C11.

also_fixed: _soft_bond_probabilities returned fp32 unconditionally (logits.float()) while the caller builds `adj` at logits.dtype, so a float64 input made index_put raise. Now casts back to logits.dtype, keeping the fp32 softmax for bf16 stability.
